subject: Gillis Field Accessibility Renovation
overview: The committee authorized linkage trust funds for park accessibility improvements and approved the closure of several inactive project accounts to consolidate remaining balances.

items.title: Account Status and Expenditure Report
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn provided updates on remaining balances and recent expenditures totaling over $50,000 across various park, road, water, and sewer linkage accounts.

items.title: Gillis Field Accessibility Renovation
items.summary: Approved the expenditure of $9,172 in Parks and Recreation Linkage Trust Funds to cover change order costs for accessibility renovations at Gillis Field.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from October 27, 2022, and October 6, 2023.

items.title: Liquidation of Inactive Project Accounts
items.summary: Approved the liquidation of several inactive project accounts, including those for Riverside Plaza Park, to return remaining balances to the general linkage fund.
